name: eos-mcp
description: eos-mcp server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: eos-mcp
plugins.description: Arista EOS device operations for Claude Code, via eAPI. Run show commands, retrieve and diff running-config, push config through a guarded configure-session with a commit timer, collect tech-support, and get a one-shot daily_brief fleet health check. Needs a local config.ini file (per-device eAPI username/password) already present on the machine; the plugin cannot create or supply that file for you.
